title: My Hero Academia
native_title: 僕のヒーローアカデミア
source: My Hero Academia manga by Kohei Horikoshi (ended 2024), including the final war and the epilogue eight years later.
world: In a world where about 80% of people have superpowers called Quirks, professional heroes are licensed public servants. Quirkless boy Izuku Midoriya inherits One For All from the Symbol of Peace, All Might, and trains at U.A. High School in Class 1-A. The heroes face the League of Villains, All For One and Tomura Shigaraki, ending in a final war that changes hero society. Hopeful, loud and full of growth.
power_system: Quirks are inborn powers that appear around age four. One For All is a stockpiling Quirk passed from user to user; All For One steals and gives Quirks. Heroes need a licence and wear support gear made for their Quirk.

places.name: U.A. High School
places.line: The top hero school; Class 1-A is Deku's class.

places.name: Kamino Ward
places.line: Site of All Might's last battle against All For One.

places.name: Jaku City
places.line: Site of the Paranormal Liberation War.

groups.name: Class 1-A
groups.line: Deku, Bakugo, Todoroki and classmates; homeroom teacher Aizawa.

groups.name: League of Villains
groups.line: Shigaraki's villain group (Dabi, Toga, Twice, Spinner, Mr. Compress).

groups.name: Pro Heroes
groups.line: Licensed heroes ranked on the Hero Billboard Chart, e.g. Endeavor and Hawks.

terms.line: The passed-down power All Might gave Deku.
The villain and Quirk that steals other Quirks.
All Might's title as the number one hero.
Every hero picks one (Deku, Dynamight, Shoto, Eraser Head).
Shigaraki's Quirk: everything he touches with all fingers crumbles.
Todoroki's Quirk: ice from the right side, fire from the left.
Bakugo's Quirk: sweat that explodes from his palms.
Aizawa's Quirk: cancels Quirks while he looks at someone.

timeline.summary: Deku enters U.A.; the League attacks the USJ.
Bakugo is kidnapped; All Might defeats All For One and retires.
Shigaraki awakens; heroes suffer huge losses.
Deku leaves U.A. to fight alone, then returns.
Deku defeats Shigaraki (Tenko); Bakugo is revived and saves All Might, finishing All For One; Dabi survives badly burned.
Eight years later Deku, without One For All, teaches at U.A. and returns as a pro hero in a suit from All Might and Class 1-A; Shoto becomes No. 2 hero; Endeavor is retired.
